protocol.json.calibration: All 34 new A/A conditions before any A/B. Use prior per-case N as initial scale only, not prior calibration. For each N: 5 samples, then 15 and 31 if baseline medians >=1 second; if below 1 second double N immediately; at most 3 N conditions. Both independent series must have A/A delta <=2 percent and all baseline medians >=1 second. Stop without comparison if any condition fails all attempts.
protocol.json.comparison: Two independent alternating-order series, one warmup excluded, max(7,accepted AA sample count); exact mathematical checksum; SHA check per worker for binaries, active forth.zig, benchmark-runtime.py. No builds/tests overlap timing.
protocol.json.criteria: Unchanged standard criteria: arithmetic and LOOP >=10 percent reduction and >2delta each series; other normal worsening <=max(3,2delta); normal CATCH <=5; THROW <=10; size <=1 percent. CATCH-only benefit is partial improvement and needs separate adoption decision; do not invent a partial threshold.
protocol.json.collection: CPU time excludes startup/compilation and includes boundary I/O. Preserve all samples; medians/min/max; no outlier removal. A/A delta is not confidence interval.
protocol.json.initial_scaling: Before new timing, seed N from prior adopted-binary candidate medians: N_new=floor(N_old*min(1,1500000/min(two saved medians))). Prior data chooses only scale, not new calibration. Target 1.5 seconds avoids unnecessarily long kernels. New A/A still must pass >=1 second and delta <=2 percent for both series.
